comments_site: Good rearing habitat - relatively deep, incised channel with mainly cutbanks and overhanging vegetation cover. Cover is not diverse but sufficient. Moderate spawning habitat - mostly gravels and sand with 10% of fines, and good holding in cutbanks - numerous RB fry observed in ~130m long section downstream of crossing. This section is critical to sustain RB population in this stream. Overwintering habitat is likely present in numerous beaver ponds and in the lake upstream. At the crossing 1000 CMP with 0.4m drop has a broken 400 CMP inside and impedes fish passage. 9m section of 400mm CMP was washed out and is located 20m downstream of crossing.
